family_label: per-layer gamma, not the retained one-gamma six-start recipe
ansatz: Each layer has its own gamma. thetaK and thetaM are shared across layers. Three shell controls per layer. G is still Hc + thetaK Khat + thetaM Mhat.
parameter_count: P = L + 2 + 3L = 4L+2. The shared-gamma count is 3L+3. Replacing its one gamma by L gammas adds L-1, which is 4L+2, not 3L+3+L.
target: same open-chain N=9 family as N9_r1, B=-0.3444, interleaved packing [[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]]
init: One normal(0, 0.35) draw at L=1. Not a six-start screen. Later depths copy the previous gamma, carry the two thetas, and interpolate shells on layer centers.
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, jac true, maxfun 120, maxiter 120, ftol 1e-12, energy only
both_rule: E < bar_E - 1e-9 and F > bar_F + 1e-9 on the same state
transfer_if: at least 24 of 48 N9 L6 states beat p11 on both, and wall time remains
L5_not_rerun: The 22-parameter L=5 pilot already lost to p11 at error 0.1766 and fidelity 0.6943. It is not repeated.
